Exam Preparation Tips (High Anxiety)
1. Practice timed mock exams
2. Use memory techniques for blank mind
3. Do deep breathing before the exam
4. Get 8 hours sleep the night before
For time management: allocate time per question
For blank mind: start with easier questions
